_instructions: PUBLIC ADDRESSES ONLY. Never put a private key, seed phrase, recovery phrase or passphrase here or anywhere else. Copy this file to deployments/addresses.json (git-ignored), fill in the seven addresses, then run: node scripts/export-deploy-bundle.mjs --addresses deployments/addresses.json
_rules: Owner signers O1-O3 and guardian signers G1-G3: six distinct people, each with their own wallet. No address in both Safes.
Each signer address must be a plain wallet account: no contract, no EIP-7702 delegation (checked on testnet).
The deployer D is a separate, dedicated account that is none of the six signers and is used for nothing else until the deployment is complete (its next nonce fixes every contract address).
Each person reads their own address from their own wallet and sends only that public address.
